title: Translate the UI into Finnish and add a language selector
acceptance: The user accepted the Finnish privacy text, agreed to keep Suomi in the language picker, and requested closure and commit before the guide. The final Android package was verified locally. Device-side system-locale switching was not independently exercised.
proposal: Offer System (default), English and Suomi in a Language combo box. Persist the choice and use English when none of the system's preferred languages is supported. Keep English and Suomi recognizable so a user can recover from a mistaken selection.
implementation: Language is in the drawer just above About. The selection takes effect immediately and is restored at startup. System follows the first supported system preference and falls back to English. The Finnish catalog includes 54 complete translations, including the accessible editor controls, Undo plurals and the list display labels. The selected locale controls the weekday header. The translator refreshes live Undo text from its original name/count without touching the recovery timer.
scope: Ship Finnish interface text, accessibility labels, plural messages, the full offline privacy policy and a Finnish overview in the App license tab. Switch languages in place and preserve the draft, list and editor position. Keep user-entered list names/items, the keyboard language and original license texts intact. The illustrated guide and store captures are tracked in UX-011.
privacy_followup: The app's privacy dialog now loads the full Finnish document when the effective app locale is Finnish, and the English document otherwise. The new production-control regression reproduces an English policy body under the Finnish dialog title on the previous build, then passes with the title, heading, content, accessible text and drawer behavior in both languages. The ARM64 APK contains both complete documents and matches all 100 tracked build inputs. The existing public English policy export still matches its English source.
license_followup: The Finnish App tab begins with QShopper's Finnish explanation of its license, source access and rebuilding instructions. The full original resource follows it, including the complete GPLv3 and Android dependency notices. Qt and Font Awesome tabs retain their complete English resources. The production drawer regression fails before the Finnish explanation and passes afterward. The model test verifies an exact round trip of the Finnish explanation and original notice.
list_labels_followup: The Lists picker shows Default and Manage lists in English, and Oletus and Hallitse listoja in Finnish. The starter list uses the existing default ID lookup and also shows its localized label in the editable catalog. The display role leaves stored names, the reserved catalog ID and the existing sort keys intact. The picker regression fails before the change with raw default shown in Finnish, then passes with both languages and the same selected ID. The model test covers duplicate names, unchanged raw roles, and the existing catalog sentinel. No database purge or schema migration is required.
verification: The final code passes the Windows model, language and About suites, picker selection, catalog sorting, popup safe-area and catalog create/rename/delete/Undo checks. The language regression also passes with native Windows rendering in a 63 mm window. The Windows app starts with Finnish in isolated settings. The ARM64 APK contains 54 translated messages, both full privacy policies and the Finnish App overview. APK verification, all 101 tracked build-input hashes and format checks pass. No final Android runtime automation was run.
